title: Field Ticket Source
description: Field Ticket contract normalized from the DocuBricks Energy library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-energy-field-ticket-source
  title: Field Ticket Source
  description: Field Ticket contract normalized from the DocuBricks Energy library.
  version: energy_field_ticket_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: energy/field_ticket
    sourcePath: Schemas/energy/field_ticket
    sourceVersion: energy_field_ticket_v1
    sourceDigest: 3dc39f1e506cdfdc4db6788f29e7488aa2ce7ba7d922560254b98ee717c1ebdc
    derivedFrom: docubricks-energy-field-ticket
spec:
  documentType: field_ticket
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - service-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - job-description
        - job-type
        - service-supervisor
        - ticket-number
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - subtotal-amount
        - tax-amount
        - total-amount
    - id: line-items
      title: Line Items
      description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - equipment-lines
        - labor-lines
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - customer-representative
        - operator-name
        - service-company-name
        - well-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - location
        - material-lines
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - approval-status
  fields:
    - id: ticket-number
      name: ticket_number
      label: Ticket Number
      description: Field ticket number.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/ticket_number
    - id: service-date
      name: service_date
      label: Service Date
      description: Date service was performed.
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/service_date
    - id: operator-name
      name: operator_name
      label: Operator Name
      description: Customer or operating company.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/operator_name
    - id: service-company-name
      name: service_company_name
      label: Service Company Name
      description: Service provider issuing the ticket.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/service_company_name
    - id: well-name
      name: well_name
      label: Well Name
      description: Well, pad, lease, or facility serviced.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/well_name
    - id: location
      name: location
      label: Location
      description: Service location.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/location
    - id: job-type
      name: job_type
      label: Job Type
      description: Type of service performed.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/job_type
    - id: job-description
      name: job_description
      label: Job Description
      description: Narrative description of the work performed.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/job_description
    - id: labor-lines
      name: labor_lines
      label: Labor Lines
      description: Labor charges with role, hours, rate, and amount.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/labor_lines
    - id: equipment-lines
      name: equipment_lines
      label: Equipment Lines
      description: Equipment charges with unit, hours, rate, and amount.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/equipment_lines
    - id: material-lines
      name: material_lines
      label: Material Lines
      description: Material charges with item, quantity, unit price, and amount.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/material_lines
    - id: subtotal-amount
      name: subtotal_amount
      label: Subtotal Amount
      description: Subtotal before tax or fees.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/subtotal_amount
    - id: tax-amount
      name: tax_amount
      label: Tax Amount
      description: Tax amount.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/tax_amount
    - id: total-amount
      name: total_amount
      label: Total Amount
      description: Total field ticket amount.
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/total_amount
    - id: customer-representative
      name: customer_representative
      label: Customer Representative
      description: Customer approver or company representative.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/customer_representative
    - id: service-supervisor
      name: service_supervisor
      label: Service Supervisor
      description: Service company supervisor.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/service_supervisor
    - id: approval-status
      name: approval_status
      label: Approval Status
      description: Signed, pending, disputed, rejected, or other approval status.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/approval_status
  validationRules:
    - id: ticket-number-present
      severity: error
      description: ticket_number is required for Field Ticket extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: ticket_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: ticket_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(ticket_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: service-date-present
      severity: error
      description: service_date is required for Field Ticket extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: service_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: service_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: service_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(service_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: operator-name-present
      severity: error
      description: operator_name is required for Field Ticket extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: operator_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: operator_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: operator_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(operator_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: service-company-name-present
      severity: error
      description: service_company_name is required for Field Ticket extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: service_company_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: service_company_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: service_company_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(service_company_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: job-type-present
      severity: error
      description: job_type is required for Field Ticket extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: job_type
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: job_type
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: job_type IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(job_type)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: total-amount-present
      severity: error
      description: total_amount is required for Field Ticket extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: total_amount
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: total_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: total_amount IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(total_amount)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: subtotal-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: subtotal_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: subtotal_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: subtotal_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: subtotal_amount IS NULL OR subtotal_amount >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: tax-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: tax_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: tax_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: tax_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: tax_amount IS NULL OR tax_amount >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: total-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: total_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: total_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: total_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: total_amount IS NULL OR total_amount >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      ticket_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Field Ticket workflow.
      service_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Field Ticket workflow.
      operator_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Field Ticket workflow.
      service_company_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Field Ticket workflow.
      job_type:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Field Ticket workflow.
      total_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Field Ticket workflow.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Field Ticket documents combine upstream operations, production accounting, field services, HSE, and
      lease control context.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      ticket_number:
        type: string
        description: Field ticket number.
      service_date:
        type: date
        description: Date service was performed.
        format: date
      operator_name:
        type: string
        description: Customer or operating company.
      service_company_name:
        type: string
        description: Service provider issuing the ticket.
      well_name:
        type: string
        description: Well, pad, lease, or facility serviced.
      location:
        type: string
        description: Service location.
      job_type:
        type: string
        description: Type of service performed.
      job_description:
        type: string
        description: Narrative description of the work performed.
      labor_lines:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            labor_line_type:
              type: string
              description: Type or class for labor_lines item.
            labor_line_description:
              type: string
              description: Description for labor_lines item.
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Amount or value when stated.
            date:
              type: date
              description: Relevant item date when stated.
              format: date
            status:
              type: string
              description: Item status or disposition when stated.
        description: Labor charges with role, hours, rate, and amount.
      equipment_lines:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            equipment_id:
              type: string
              description: Equipment unit, serial, or asset identifier.
            equipment_type:
              type: string
              description: Equipment type.
            description:
              type: string
              description: Equipment or service line description.
            hours:
              type: number
              description: Billable equipment hours.
            rate:
              type: number
              description: Billing rate.
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Line amount.
        description: Equipment charges with unit, hours, rate, and amount.
      material_lines:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            material_line_type:
              type: string
              description: Type or class for material_lines item.
            material_line_description:
              type: string
              description: Description for material_lines item.
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Amount or value when stated.
            date:
              type: date
              description: Relevant item date when stated.
              format: date
            status:
              type: string
              description: Item status or disposition when stated.
        description: Material charges with item, quantity, unit price, and amount.
      subtotal_amount:
        type: number
        description: Subtotal before tax or fees.
      tax_amount:
        type: number
        description: Tax amount.
      total_amount:
        type: number
        description: Total field ticket amount.
      customer_representative:
        type: string
        description: Customer approver or company representative.
      service_supervisor:
        type: string
        description: Service company supervisor.
      approval_status:
        type: string
        description: Signed, pending, disputed, rejected, or other approval status.
    required:
      - ticket_number
      - service_date
      - operator_name
      - service_company_name
      - job_type
      - total_amount
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: energy_field_services
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - ticket_number
          - service_date
          - operator_name
          - service_company_name
          - job_type
          - total_amount
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - line_items
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields:
          - labor_lines
          - equipment_lines
          - material_lines
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
